name: ChangesPanel
description: A file against what was last saved.

name: ChangesView
description: Files with unsaved edits, each opening its comparison with what was saved.

name: CodeEditor
description: Edits a document of any size in a bounded box.

name: CodeField
description: Code in a form: a `Field` holding an editor, so it has a label, a hint and an error like any other control, and works with `useAppForm` through `value`, `onValueChange` and `onBlur`.

name: CodeViewer
description: Shows code of any size, with the same scrolling and highlighting, and no editing.

name: EditorArea
description: The tabbed, splittable editors and the panels beneath them.

name: ExplorerView
description: The Explorer: open files, then the project's folders, with a filter that stays put.

name: OutputPanel
description: A running record of what the workbench did.

name: ProblemsPanel
description: Every open file's diagnostics, grouped by file, from whichever provider the application connected.

name: SearchView
description: Search across files: `backend.search` when the application has one, otherwise in the page.

name: TimelineView
description: The active file's undo history as a timeline, with its branches.

name: WelcomePanel
description: What an editor stack shows when nothing is open.

name: Workbench
description: An IDE as one component: application frame, activity rail, side views, tabbed and splittable editors, code windows, panels, menus, commands and a status bar.

name: WorkbenchMenubar
description: The workbench's menus, built from its commands, so a menu row, a shortcut and the palette always agree.

name: WorkbenchProvider
description: Holds a workbench's open files, layout, commands and dialogs, and draws nothing else.

name: WorkbenchStatusBar
description: The bar under a workbench: problems, the caret, the file's size and any shortcut in progress.
